infra.trail.err.BAD_OUTPUT: CloudTrail returned something this screen could not read.
infra.trail.err.BAD_WINDOW: That time window is not valid.
infra.trail.err.WINDOW_TOO_OLD: CloudTrail only keeps 90 days of lookup history. Pick a shorter window.
infra.trail.externalWhy: No AWOG log line matches this event, so something outside AWOG made the call: the console, a pipeline, or another person. It can also mean AWOG ran a high-level command that maps to a different API name.
infra.trail.matchedWhy: Matched to an AWOG log line at {at}. The match is inferred from the operation name and timing — there is no shared id — so treat it as a strong hint, not proof.
infra.trail.more: more events exist — narrow the window
infra.trail.noSidecar: The engine is not running, so CloudTrail cannot be queried.
infra.trail.resourceWhy: Give a resource id or name to see only the events that touched it.
infra.trail.subtitle: What the account was actually changed by — including anyone who was not using AWOG.
infra.trail.title: CloudTrail
